content: devenv v1.8.1 uses git-hooks.nix revision fa466640195d38ec97cf0493d6d6882bc4d14969; git-hooks.enable is unsupported, and verification cleanup intentionally uses a third root-owned workspace mount.

title: Pin git-hooks.nix revision compatible with devenv v1.8.1
rationale: The archived image verifier still recursed while evaluating the older fa466640 revision; pin the resolved 16ec914 revision and NAR hash used by the working project lock shape, while retaining the git-hooks integration and devenv shell.

title: Follow project nixpkgs in devenv git-hooks input
rationale: The devenv manifest must declare inputs.nixpkgs.follows: nixpkgs so git-hooks evaluates against the project's pinned nixpkgs graph; the existing version-7 lock already encoded this edge, so no lock regeneration changed it.
